0.why: HPFCore.cc:34 divides this jack by 5V and HPFCore.cc:35 clamps the knob-plus-jack total between -1 and 1 before setPitchMultiple at math.hh:252 raises 2 to five times it, which is one octave per volt in both directions

1.why: HPFCore.cc:21 takes the voice count from this jack and HPFCore.cc:38 filters it per voice

0.why: HPFCore.cc:24 sets this output's channel count from the audio input

comment: The knob is configured over 130 to 2093 Hz (HPF_info.hh:19) and the maker's manual repeats that, but HPFCore.cc:49 turns the parameter into -1 to +1 and HPFCore.cc:35 multiplies 523.25Hz by two raised to five times it, which is 16.35Hz to 16744Hz. The Q knob's configured 1x to 20x holds only in STANDARD mode; HPFCore.cc:57 maps it 0 to 10 in KORG mode.
